Read-only access is enough: add us as a guest or give view access in your workspace. We never need your password and we do not change anything during an audit.
Will you fix the problems you find?
The audit is a report, not a repair. You can use the fix list yourself, give it to your developer or order one of our services to do the work. We can quote it straight from the report.
Is the audit useful for a brand new site?
Yes, it is a good pre-launch check. We look for broken links, missing titles, slow images and mobile issues before visitors find them.
How do I get the call?
The 1-on-1 call comes with the Premium package, or you can add it to the others. We book a time that suits you after the report is delivered, so you can ask about what you read.
desc:
A Webflow site audit is a page-by-page review of your site that ends in a clear fix list. Ecom Swift LLC checks structure, speed, SEO basics, mobile layout, accessibility, forms and the CMS, then tells you what to repair first.

## What is a Webflow site audit?

A Webflow site audit is a structured inspection of a live Webflow project that finds problems and ranks them by importance. It looks at how the site is built in the Designer, how it performs in a browser and how it reads to a search engine. You receive a documented report with clear findings and no guesswork.

Most owners know something is off. Pages feel slow, a form seems quiet, or the phone layout looks cramped, but they cannot say which problem matters most. An audit turns a general worry into a short list of specific jobs.

## Why a review before any redesign saves money

Webflow sites grow by accident. A freelancer adds a section, a new teammate duplicates a page, an old script stays in the project settings, and a year later nobody remembers why things are built the way they are. Fixing the wrong thing first is the most common waste of budget.

A review shows whether your real problem is design, speed, search visibility or a broken form. Sometimes a small repair beats a full rebuild. Sometimes the report proves a rebuild is the right call, and then you can brief it properly.

## How an audit affects leads, speed and search visibility

Visitors judge a site in a few seconds. Heavy images, layout shifts and tiny tap targets on a phone send people away before they read a word. A form that fails silently loses an enquiry that cost real money to attract.

Search engines read the same signals. Duplicate titles, skipped heading levels, missing alt text and broken redirects make a site harder to understand. Fixing them does not promise a ranking, but it removes obstacles that you control. The audit tells you which obstacles are real on your site rather than generic advice.

## What a thorough Webflow audit covers

- Page titles, meta descriptions and heading order on each reviewed page.
- Image sizes, formats and alt text, with notes on what slows loading.
- Mobile and tablet layouts, including tap targets and text size.
- Form behavior: required fields, success messages, notification emails and spam protection.
- Accessibility basics such as color contrast, link text, focus visibility and landmark structure.
- CMS structure: collection fields, template pages, empty fields and duplicate items.
- Class naming, unused styles and repeated components that make editing harder.
- Redirects, 404 pages and sitemap settings.
- Embedded scripts and third-party widgets that add weight.
- Navigation, calls to action and the path from the home page to a contact or purchase step.

## How the work runs

You choose a package based on how many pages need review. The Basic package is a quick health check of your key pages with the top fixes in a short PDF. The Standard package covers more pages and adds accessibility, forms and CMS review, with every finding sorted by priority. The Premium package goes deeper into technical search, redirects and a comparison with two competitor sites, and finishes with a step-by-step action plan.

We open your site in read-only mode where possible, test it on real devices and record each finding with a plain explanation and the simple steps to fix it. You can add a 30-minute call if you want us to walk through the report and answer questions live. Extra pages and a competitor snapshot are available as add-ons.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Share the pages that matter most to your business, such as the home page, services and contact page.
- Tell us what you already suspect is wrong.
- Mention any goal, such as more enquiries or a faster mobile experience.
- Send a list of tools connected to the site, like analytics or email forms.
- Decide who will apply the fixes before the report arrives.

**Avoid:**
- Editing the site heavily while the review is in progress.
- Treating every finding as equally urgent.
- Fixing small cosmetic items before broken forms or slow pages.
- Expecting the report to change the site by itself.
- Asking for an audit only after a rebuild has already started.

## Who this service is for

This service suits owners whose Webflow site was built by someone else and who want an honest second opinion. It also fits marketers who inherit a site and need to know what they are dealing with, and agencies or founders deciding between a repair and a full redesign. A brand new site can benefit too, as a final check before launch.

## What we need from you

Send the site address and a short note about your goals. We never need your password. For a deeper review, we can be invited to your workspace or site as a collaborator with limited access, and you can remove us when the report is delivered. After you order, we reply with a short checklist and keep you updated until the report is in your inbox.
